content: MS Dānishgāh 2576 (12th/18th century, defective, grammatical errors throughout) is a hybrid collection whose Munshaʾāt-i Turka (pp. 168-217) here holds the remaining 32 (of 46) letters as found in MS Majlis-i Sinā 316 pp. 10-34, beginning mid-page with letter no. 15. Because what survives corresponds so closely to the Sinā 316 version, MK infers a standard collection of Ibn Turka's correspondence that may survive in other, unidentified copies.
